Vision and values
Our vision is to become the energy company that others measure themselves against. These are the values we ask every person here to live by, in every office and on every site, every working day. They apply to every one of us, from the newest recruit to the chairman of the board, and we ask each other to point it out when we fall short.
respect We treat others as we would like to be treated ourselves. We do not tolerate abusive or careless treatment of anyone. Ruthlessness, callousness and arrogance have no place at Calderon.
integrity We work with customers and suppliers openly, honestly and sincerely. When we say we will do something, we do it. When we say we cannot or will not do something, we will not do it.
our people That's why we hire only the most talented people we can find. We give them room to take on new work and we expect a great deal of them. Their success is the success of the whole company.
our markets We believe in the lasting good sense of free and open markets. We think customers are best served when they can choose among suppliers and compare what each one offers.

Calderon was formed in 1986 from the merger of two regional pipeline operators and now runs pipelines, power plants and a trading desk in more than twenty countries. About 18,000 people work for the company.
Our trading business lets a utility lock in the price of gas or power months ahead, so that a cold winter or a hot summer does not upset its budget for the year.
